$comment: Reverse-engineered from app/globals.css's @theme block, the single source of truth in the codebase for these values (see docs/DESIGN_CONSTITUTION.md). Every value below is copied verbatim from committed CSS, not invented. 'status: defined_not_consumed' marks a token that exists in globals.css but isn't yet read by the component it names — that gap is real and part of the current implementation, not an omission in this file.

chrome_navy.usage: top bar, dock, window frames, hardware chrome faces

identity_navy.usage: logo mark / hero identity text only
identity_navy.note: declared but no component reads it yet

selection_blue.usage: active indicators, dock LED, keyboard focus ring, Build Playback pulse/glow

outline.usage: declared alias for the primary dark ink color
outline.note: components still reference --color-ink directly, which now resolves to the same hex

legacy_accent_red.usage: Architect node-type color, Boot/System accents, window close button fill

legacy_accent_blue.usage: Architect node-type color, window 'stack' button fill, focused-window glow ring, react-flow selected edge

legacy_accent_gold.usage: Architect node-type color, window minimize button fill

legacy_accent_purple.usage: Architect node-type color, 'Welcome back, Creator.' name highlight

surface_bg_dim.usage: window frame fill, inactive folder-tab fill, dock rail background

surface_solid.usage: window content area / molded panel face

grid_unit.note: documented base unit; components mostly use Tailwind's own spacing scale (which is also 4px/8px-based) rather than this var directly

icon.asset_note: actual PNG assets in public/icons/*.png are NOT uniformly 24x24 — intrinsic sizes range ~48-66px per components/Dock/AppIcon.tsx's DIMS table (e.g. explorer 66x57, home 54x54, forge 64x48); the 24px grid token governs rendered/display size via className, not source asset dimensions

hairline.note: components use --color-border / --color-border-strong 1px borders directly (e.g. Tailwind border-border) rather than this var

title_bar_height.actual_implementation: 44px (h-11, components/Window/Window.tsx line 79; also TopBar.tsx uses h-11)

chamfer.actual_implementation: rounded-md / rounded-t-[3px] (soft border-radius, not a hard chamfer)

typography.note: see docs/TYPOGRAPHY.md for full extracted usage; families only, here

font_body.value: "Inter Variable", -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif

corner_radius_survey.note: frequency count across all .tsx files (grep, not a token — the codebase has no single radius scale; this is what's actually there)
